newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sammi Steel, Sammi Corp fall.
newsitem.headline: Sammi Steel, Sammi Corp fall.

text.p: Shares of Sammi Steel Co and Sammi Corp, both flagship units of South Korea's Sammi Group, fell to their daily limits on rumours the group has been suffering from financial difficulties, brokers said.
Sammi Steel fell 250 won to 4,070 and Sammi Corp shed 190 won to 3,010.
A Sammi Group spokesman denied the rumours.

Brokers said rumours had been circulating for some time but attracted special attention on Friday due to newspaper reports that the group had to borrow from banks to pay back convertible bonds on maturity.
The Sammi Group spokesman confirmed it had settled the payment, valued at 46 billion won, with bank loans, but denied that was linked to financial difficulties.
Sammi Steel shares were most actively traded while Sammi Corp ranked third on the actives list.
Volume on Sammi Steel totalled 1.44 million shares and that on Sammi Corp reached 333,740 shares.
